index.makeTheMost: Make the Most of Your Visit

koraPreview.label: AI Monastery Guide
koraPreview.description: Named for the ritual circuit walked clockwise around a monastery, Kora answers questions on history, lineage, festivals, etiquette, and helps you discover Sikkim's rich Buddhist heritage with intelligent, personalized guidance.
koraPreview.groundedDetail: Answers limited to the four monasteries — it says so when it doesn't know.
koraPreview.streamingDetail: Replies arrive word by word, first token in under a second.
koraPreview.contextualDetail: Remembers your budget, dates and interests across the conversation.
koraPreview.mockQuestion1: I only have 2 days and I'm starting in Gangtok — which monastery should I visit first?
koraPreview.mockAnswer1: Start with the two closest to Gangtok. Rumtek, the seat of the Karma Kagyu lineage, sits about 24 km out across the valley. Enchey is barely 3 km from town and is known for its masked Cham dances. Both fit comfortably into one day.
koraPreview.mockQuestion2: Perfect, and what about day two?
